**Finding: Compliant (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

Summary of the review:

- **Make-Whole Payment (§§ 8.1–8.2, p0351/p0354/p0355/p0358/p0359/p0362; definition p0791–p0800):** a yield-maintenance premium payable to **Noteholders** on a voluntary Optional Redemption elected by the Class A Certificateholder, funded through the agreed waterfall and conditioned on sufficient funds. It is investor economics, not a breach-triggered liquidated sum payable to Cellco. The Clean-Up Redemption is expressly available *without* any Make-Whole Payment.
- **Late fees / prepayment charges (p0094, p0990):** these are components of the Supplemental Servicing Fee collected **from Obligors**, not amounts we pay.
- **Servicing transition costs (p0347):** expressly "paid by the resigning or terminated Servicer" — runs in our favour.
- **Successor Servicer $150,000 fee (p0339):** third-party compensation paid under the Indenture waterfall, not a penalty on us.
- **Indemnities (p0291–p0292):** run from the Servicer and Marketing Agent to the Issuer — again in our favour.
- Targeted searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "termination fee", "premium/prepayment charge" and Issuer payment obligations returned nothing responsive against our side.

No Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties exist, so the preferred element is already met and the fallback early-termination-fee cap is not engaged.
